channel.title: Inside Out: One Body Fact a Day
channel.description:
One-minute episodes about how the human body works, starting with what happens to food after you swallow it. Plain-language science for curious learners, students and teachers. Educational, not medical advice.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Body Unpacked: Health Atlas, an iPhone app that lets you follow a food into your body and explore how it works. Body Unpacked: Health Atlas on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
